features.name: donation_frequency_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total donations (V2) to months since first donation (V1), capturing donation rate over lifetime
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures donation intensity normalized by donor tenure; frequent recent donors more likely to donate again

features.name: recency_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree-splittable ordinal encoding of recency; very recent donors have higher return probability
features.formula: 1 if V1 <= 3 else (2 if V1 <= 7 else (3 if V1 <= 14 else 4))

features.name: is_very_recent_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator: 1 if months since last donation (V1) <= 3, else 0
features.expected_model_benefit: Strong binary split signal; very recent donors are most likely to donate again

features.name: blood_volume_per_donation
features.description: Average blood volume donated per visit: total volume (V3) divided by total donations (V2)
features.expected_model_benefit: Consistency check; should be ~250cc per donation; outliers may indicate data anomalies or high-volume donors

features.name: high_frequency_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator: 1 if total donations (V2) >= 5, else 0; marks habitual donors
features.expected_model_benefit: Habitual donors with 5+ donations are more likely to continue donating

features.name: tenure_to_recency_ratio
features.description: Ratio of months since first donation (V4) to months since last donation (V1); higher values indicate long-term donors who donated recently
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures loyalty and recency interaction; long-tenure recent donors are prime candidates for repeat donation

features.name: donation_density
features.description: Donations per month of tenure: V2 / V4; measures how densely packed donations are over donor lifetime
features.expected_model_benefit: High density donors are habitual and likely to donate again; good nonlinear split feature

features.name: long_tenure_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator: 1 if months since first donation (V4) >= 36, else 0; marks established long-term donors
features.expected_model_benefit: Long-tenure donors have demonstrated sustained commitment; useful binary split for tree models

features.name: recency_frequency_interaction
features.description: Product of inverse recency and frequency: (1/V1) * V2; high values indicate frequent and recent donors
features.expected_model_benefit: Nonlinear RFM interaction captures the joint effect of recency and frequency; strong predictor of return donation

features.name: volume_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket of total blood volume (V3): 1=low (<=500), 2=medium (501-1500), 3=high (1501-3000), 4=very high (3000+)
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretized volume for direct tree splits; high-volume donors have stronger donation history
features.formula: 1 if V3 <= 500 else (2 if V3 <= 1500 else (3 if V3 <= 3000 else 4))

features.name: dormancy_risk_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of donor dormancy risk based on recency and frequency patterns: 1=low risk (recent+frequent), 2=moderate risk, 3=high risk (distant+infrequent). Assessed by combining V1 > 12 and V2 < 3 thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures semantic risk of donor lapsing; high dormancy risk donors less likely to return

features.name: rfm_composite_score
features.description: Composite RFM score: normalized sum of recency score (14-V1 clipped to 0), frequency score (V2), and monetary score (V3/250); higher is better donor profile
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite score summarizing full RFM profile; enables tree to split on overall donor quality
